strategies.name: Detection Strategy for Forged SAML Tokens

analytics.name: Analytic 0418
analytics.guidance: Forged SAML tokens can be observed as authentication attempts with valid signatures but missing expected preceding Kerberos or authentication events. Defenders may correlate SAML assertions with absent Event IDs 4769, 1200, or 1202, or tokens issued with abnormal lifetimes, issuers, or claims compared to baseline.

tuning.description: Defines the maximum expected lifetime of a SAML token (e.g., >1 hour considered anomalous).
List of approved SAML issuers and certificate thumbprints.

log_sources.name: azure:signinlogs
log_sources.channel: SAML-based login with anomalous issuer or NotOnOrAfter lifetime

analytics.name: Analytic 0419
analytics.guidance: Forged SAML tokens in IaaS environments often manifest as cross-cloud or cross-account authentication without matching STS events. Defenders may see AssumeRole or GetFederationToken API usage without a corresponding SAML assertion log from the trusted IdP.

tuning.description: Flag SAML tokens used across unexpected accounts or cloud tenants.

log_sources.name: CloudTrail:Signin
log_sources.channel: SAML login without corresponding IdP authentication log

analytics.name: Analytic 0420
analytics.guidance: Forged SAML tokens may be used on Windows systems to authenticate to federated apps without normal Kerberos activity. Defenders may detect anomalous event correlation, where access to SaaS/O365 via SAML occurs without prior TGT requests or user logons.

tuning.description: Number of unusual claims in a SAML token (e.g., excessive privileges).

log_sources.name: WinEventLog:ADFS
log_sources.channel: Token issuance events showing anomalous claims or issuers

analytics.name: Analytic 0421
analytics.guidance: Forged SAML tokens can appear as SaaS logins where authentication succeeded without MFA, or where tokens contain claims inconsistent with the user profile. Look for concurrent sessions across different geographies with the same SAML assertion ID.

tuning.description: Triggers when same SAML token used in different geographies within short timeframe.

log_sources.name: saas:access
log_sources.channel: SAML token accepted without preceding login challenge

log_sources.name: m365:unified
log_sources.channel: Abnormal user claims or unexpected elevated role assignment in SAML assertion

analytics.name: Analytic 0422
analytics.guidance: Forged SAML tokens may be leveraged to access O365 apps such as Outlook or SharePoint. Defenders should monitor for token replay across multiple clients or access attempts to privileged mailboxes without prior interactive login.

tuning.description: Number of times a token is reused within short timeframe.

log_sources.name: m365:exchange
log_sources.channel: Mailbox access using SAML token without corresponding MFA event

log_sources.name: m365:sharepoint
log_sources.channel: File access with forged or anomalous SAML claims
